Dawn: first light of dawn, cool blue-pink sky gradient, quiet low sun
Morning: clear morning light, fresh cooler key, soft long shadows
Midday: midday overhead light, shorter shadows, brighter exposure
Afternoon: afternoon light with warmer tilt, comfortable outdoor contrast
Golden hour: golden hour low sun, amber warmth, long edge light
Dusk: dusk transition, fading warm residual light into cooler sky
Evening: evening practicals and residual sky glow, settled night approach
Night: nighttime, artificial practicals dominate, deep ambient darkness
